d: First-contact and outer-system landmarks from Arthur C. Clarke’s standalone classics.

mercury.x: Scientific observation base and headquarters of Project Spaceguard tracking the 50-kilometer alien cylinder Rama during its perihelion slingshot.

titan.x: Commercial hydrogen mining colony on Saturn’s moon Titan supplying reaction mass across the Solar System in Imperial Earth.

hip-30438.x: F0Ib supergiant star 310 light-years away; home system of Karellen and the Overlords overseeing humanity’s evolutionary culmination in Childhood’s End.

b.s: Milestone speculative works depicting humanity’s encounters with transcendent alien intelligence and outer solar colonisation.
b.r: Childhood’s End (1953), Rendezvous with Rama (1973), Imperial Earth (1975)
